This study used a nested case-controlled design to analyze the functional potential of the fecal microbiome in infants enrolled in the CHILD Study. We selected 3-month and 1-year stool samples from an atopy enriched subset of children from one enrollment center (Vancouver). DNA was extracted from stool samples and submitted for shotgun metagenome sequencing.
